name: CatalogLens for Shopify
tagline: See any Shopify store's theme, apps and catalog, and export its products to CSV.
how: See whether it runs on Shopify, its theme, apps, product count, prices and newest products, then export the catalog.
fields: Title, URL, vendor, type, tags, dates, price range, compare-at price, discount, stock, options, image link and description. Pro adds one row per variant with SKU and availability.
free: Shopify check, theme, apps and catalog stats
pro: One row per variant with SKU, price and stock
Watchlist: see how many products a store added since your last check
who: Dropshippers and product researchers, Shopify agencies sizing up a prospect, app makers and anyone comparing prices across stores.
note: CatalogLens for Shopify is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shopify Inc.
faq: Does it work on stores that aren't on Shopify?
It tells you whether a store runs on Shopify. Theme, app and catalog details are only available for Shopify stores.
How many products can it export?
Free exports up to 100 products. Pro exports the full catalog, including stores with thousands of products, with one row per variant.

How do I unlock Pro after paying?
Your license key is shown on the receipt page and emailed to you. Open the extension, paste the key into "Paste license key" and click Activate.
Can I use it on more than one computer?
Yes. One key works on up to 3 browsers, for example your work and home computers.
I lost my license key. Where do I find it?
Search your email for the receipt, or sign in to your Gumroad library with the email you paid with. The key is on the receipt.
Does it work in Brave, Edge or Opera?
Yes. It installs from the Chrome Web Store into any Chromium-based browser.
